description: Change a post that is still QUEUED — move it to a different time, rewrite the caption, swap the media, add or drop a channel, or change which board / Page / company Page / listing / account (`accounts`) it goes to. PASS ONLY WHAT CHANGES: an omitted field is left exactly as it was, and an explicit empty string CLEARS one (linkedinOrganizationId:"" moves a company-Page post back to the person’s own profile). The edited item is re-checked against the identical rules its create passed — visibility the channel can honour, per-channel length, media the channel can carry — so an edit can never slip past a refusal that a create would have caught. Get the id from list_scheduled. Something that already went out cannot be changed: a published post is edited or removed with manage_meta_post / manage_linkedin_post / delete_x_post, not rescheduled.

accounts.description: WHICH account on a channel holding several, as on schedule_post: {"x":["@brand"]} or "all"; null clears. Only the channels named change; checked against the connected accounts.

actionType.description: GOOGLE BUSINESS — the call-to-action button; "" clears it.

aiGenerated.description: AI-CONTENT DISCLOSURE, as schedule_post’s aiGenerated. OMIT IT and the value already on the post stays; a post that never had one is decided from provenance at publish: a Hermoso render is declared AI-generated, media from upload_file or an external URL (the user’s own photos or footage) is NOT. Pass true or false only to override.

altText.description: ACCESSIBILITY — replace the screen-reader description(s). A STRING describes every slide; an ARRAY describes them one at a time in slide order and REPLACES the whole list. "" clears it.

at.description: the new time: local wall clock (2026-10-30T10:00, read in `timezone` or the brand’s zone on that date), UTC (…Z) or epoch ms. Future, at most 365 days out.

audience.description: FACEBOOK — replaces who can see the Page post {countries, regions, cities, minAge}; {} removes the limit.

cities.description: Meta city keys (the ads location search)

minAge.description: Facebook Page post audience: minimum age, one of 13, 15, 18, 21 or 25

regions.description: Meta region keys (the ads location search)

audioId.description: INSTAGRAM REEL — an Instagram licensed track id from search_instagram_audio; an empty string removes it. Same rules as schedule_post’s audioId (Reels only, on an Instagram connected through Meta).

audioName.description: INSTAGRAM REEL — replaces the audio track name; an empty string removes it.

audioVolume.description: INSTAGRAM REEL — how loud that track plays, 0–100 (Instagram’s default 100). Needs audioId.

boardId.description: PINTEREST — move the Pin to a different board (list_pinterest_boards)

brand.description: WHICH PROFILE this post is in (an id or exact name from list_brands), when it is not the profile this connection is pinned to. A name that matches no profile, or two, is REFUSED.

brandPartner.description: YOUTUBE: sponsoring brand channel (UC… or @handle); "" removes it

brandedContent.description: TIKTOK — the paid-partnership disclosure; false turns it off.

brandedContentSponsorIds.description: INSTAGRAM — replaces the sponsor user ids behind the paid-partnership label (at most 2); [] removes them.

buttons.description: TELEGRAM ONLY — replace the URL buttons ([] removes them).

callToAction.description: FACEBOOK — replaces the button on the Page post; "" removes it.

callToActionLink.description: FACEBOOK — replaces where the button goes; an empty string falls back to the post link.

captionTrack.description: YOUTUBE: replace the queued caption track (url OR text, plus language).

captions.description: replaces the WHOLE per-channel caption map — send every override you want to keep, not just the new one

categoryId.description: YOUTUBE: NUMERIC category id; "" goes back to the default (22).

channelOptions.description: rare per-channel extras: threadsChain[] / blueskyThread[] follow-ups threaded under it; linkedinPoll {question, options[], duration ONE_DAY|THREE_DAYS|SEVEN_DAYS|FOURTEEN_DAYS} a poll as the post; linkedinReshareOf repost this (link or urn); ytPlaylistId add to playlist; protectContent Telegram no forwarding/saving; telegramDocument file URL sent as the post; slackUsername / slackIconUrl / slackIconEmoji (:rocket:) the Slack app posts as that name and picture; sensitiveMedia [adult_content|graphic_violence|other] X media warning; geoRestriction {countries[] | excludeCountries[]} X media country limit (two-letter codes); textBackgroundPresetId Facebook text-only post on a coloured background (numeric preset id); tiktokLocationId + tiktokLocationName (search_tiktok_locations), tiktokMusicSoundId (songClipId from tiktok_ads_trending sounds), tiktokMusicVolume / tiktokOriginalSoundVolume 0-100, tiktokAdsOnly TikTok video as an ads-only post

chatId.description: TELEGRAM — send it to a different chat, group or channel (@username or numeric id). It can be changed but never cleared: telegram cannot publish without one.

collaborators.description: INSTAGRAM — replaces the WHOLE collab list (up to 3 usernames); an explicit [] removes the co-authors and the post goes out as an ordinary single-author post. Only takes effect if the post has not fired yet — an invite already sent cannot be withdrawn from here.

commercialContent.description: TIKTOK — the COMMERCIAL CONTENT DISCLOSURE, as schedule_post’s commercialContent: needs yourBrand and/or brandedContent with it.

communityId.description: X — the community to publish into; an empty string goes back to the main timeline.

countryCodes.description: THREADS ONLY — two-letter country codes limiting who can see the post.

coverAtMs.description: THE VIDEO COVER on every channel, as one frame in milliseconds (see schedule_post).

coverImageUrl.description: THE VIDEO COVER on every channel, as a Hermoso-hosted picture (see schedule_post).

coverTimestampMs.description: TIKTOK VIDEO ONLY — cover frame in milliseconds.

coverUrl.description: INSTAGRAM REEL — replaces the cover image url; an empty string removes it.

crossreshareDarkMode.description: THREADS ONLY — dark-mode that Instagram Story. Needs crossreshareToIg.

crossreshareToIg.description: THREADS ONLY — also share to Instagram as a Story when it fires; false turns it off. Refused on a carousel.

description.description: YOUTUBE — replace the video description; "" clears it and the caption is used.

disableComment.description: TIKTOK — comments off on this post.

discordChannel.description: DISCORD bot: channel id or #name (default: the brand's)

discordReplyTo.description: DISCORD bot: reply to this message id

discordStartThread.description: DISCORD bot: open a thread under the post, this title

event.description: GOOGLE BUSINESS — replaces the whole event record {title, startDate, startTime, endDate, endTime}.

title.description: event headline (required for an event or offer post)

excerpt.description: BLOG — the excerpt under the title

externalId.description: your own id for the post ("" clears)

firstComment.description: FIRST COMMENT posted as the same account right after it publishes (Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn company Pages); same rules as schedule_post’s firstComment.

fit.description: as schedule_post’s fit: only on the user’s yes after a shape refusal, pad (true) or crop the post’s out-of-range photo to the range its channels take. The fitted copy replaces it on the post.

id.description: the scheduled post id from list_scheduled

ideaId.description: short id of the content-plan idea this post came from

imageUrls.description: replace the CAROUSEL slides, in order; an empty array [] drops the carousel and goes back to a single image. Omit to leave the slides exactly as they are. The edited item is re-checked against the same carousel rules the create passed, so adding a channel that cannot swipe is refused now rather than posting slide 1 later.

instagramCommentPrompt.description: INSTAGRAM — make the caption a COMMENT PROMPT that people answer in the comments. Same limits as instagramPoll, and never together with it.

instagramLocationId.description: INSTAGRAM — replaces the tagged place (the numeric id of its Facebook Page); an empty string removes it. Not locationId, which is the Google Business listing.

instagramPoll.description: INSTAGRAM POLL — 2–4 answers of 1–25 characters, the caption is the question; same rules as schedule_post’s instagramPoll. WRITE-ONCE: it cannot be changed after the post publishes.

instagramPollExtended.description: INSTAGRAM — extended poll voting, only with instagramPoll; as schedule_post’s instagramPollExtended.

labels.description: your own labels (replaces the list; [] clears)

link.description: destination URL for a Pinterest Pin, Facebook text post or Google Business post

linkAttachment.description: THREADS ONLY — a full http(s) URL rendered as a link card on a TEXT-ONLY post. The only way a Threads post carries a destination.

linkDescription.description: FACEBOOK — replaces the link preview description; an empty string removes the override.

linkName.description: FACEBOOK — replaces the link preview headline; an empty string removes the override.

linkPicture.description: FACEBOOK — replaces the link preview image url; an empty string removes the override.

linkedinOrganizationId.description: LINKEDIN — target a different company Page, or "" to post as the connected person instead

madeWithAi.description: X — the AI-media label; false turns it off.

message.description: replace the caption used for every channel that has no override

metadata.description: your own key/value notes (replaces them; {} clears)

notifySubscribers.description: YOUTUBE: notify subscribers when it goes live.

offer.description: GOOGLE BUSINESS — replaces the whole offer record {couponCode, redeemOnlineUrl, termsConditions}.

redeemOnlineUrl.description: link where the offer is redeemed online

termsConditions.description: terms text shown with the offer

optimizeCopy.description: fit the shared caption to each channel’s rules, as schedule_post’s optimizeCopy (a per-channel caption is left as written). Send false to switch it off on this item.

pageId.description: FACEBOOK / INSTAGRAM / THREADS — publish from a different connected Page (list_meta_pages)

paidPartnership.description: INSTAGRAM AND X — the paid-partnership label; false turns it off.

paidProductPlacement.description: YOUTUBE: paid product placement (shows the disclosure) — false removes it

parseMode.description: TELEGRAM ONLY — 'HTML' for Telegram's HTML tags.

place.description: FACEBOOK — replaces the tagged place (the numeric id of its Facebook Page); an empty string removes it.

placeName.description: the name the user saw for that place; a different business is refused

platformCover.description: VIDEO COVER, as schedule_post’s platformCover: omitted, Hermoso sets the video’s best frame as the cover; true = let the platform pick. A cover you pass always wins.

poll.description: X — replaces the poll; an empty options list removes it.

privacyLevel.description: TIKTOK privacy level: the USER picks it from the options tiktok_creator_info returns, never a default or a guess; same rules as schedule_post’s privacyLevel.

quotePostId.description: THREADS ONLY — the id of the Threads post this one quotes.

recipe.description: the post's FORMAT id, e.g. "slideshow" or "imessage_chat" — post_performance groups by it, so reuse one id per format

replySettings.description: X — who may reply; "" goes back to everyone.

shareToFeed.description: INSTAGRAM REEL — whether the Reel also shows in the Feed grid.

slackChannel.description: SLACK app: channel id or #name (default: the brand's)

slackThreadTs.description: SLACK app: reply in this thread (parent ts)

slideText.description: PINTEREST CAROUSEL ONLY — per-slide title / description / link, aligned to slide order.

story.description: INSTAGRAM — true makes it a 24-hour Story, false an ordinary feed post. One image or one video, no carousel.

tags.description: YOUTUBE — replaces the WHOLE tag list; an empty array [] clears the tags.

targetAudience.description: LINKEDIN COMPANY PAGE — replaces who sees the post (facet ids from search_linkedin_ads_targeting); {} removes the limit. The matching audience must be over 300 followers.

organizations.description: urn:li:organization (school or company) or numeric id

staffCountRanges.description: LinkedIn company size bands, e.g. SIZE_11_TO_50

thread.description: X — replaces the WHOLE thread; an explicit [] drops back to a single post using the caption.

threadsGhostPost.description: THREADS ONLY — a text-only GHOST post Threads archives after 24 hours; same rules as schedule_post’s threadsGhostPost.

threadsGif.description: THREADS ONLY — a GIPHY GIF id (the id in a giphy.com/gifs/… link) attached to a TEXT Threads post. GIPHY is the only provider Threads takes.

threadsLongText.description: THREADS ONLY — long-form text attachment (up to 10,000 characters) under a TEXT-only Threads post; same rules as schedule_post’s threadsLongText.

thumbOffset.description: INSTAGRAM REEL — replaces the cover frame, in milliseconds; 0 removes it. Never together with coverUrl.

thumbnailUrl.description: YOUTUBE: replace the custom thumbnail; "" goes back to a frame of the video, "auto" to YouTube’s pick.

title.description: PINTEREST / YOUTUBE — replace the headline; "" clears it and goes back to deriving one from the caption

topicTag.description: THREADS ONLY — one topic tag, without the leading #.

topicType.description: GOOGLE BUSINESS — the kind of Post; EVENT and OFFER both require `event`.

trialReel.description: INSTAGRAM — replaces the trial-reel setting on a queued Reel (MANUAL or SS_PERFORMANCE); an explicit "" turns the trial off and it goes out as an ordinary Reel. Only takes effect while the post is still queued — a Reel already published cannot be converted into a trial.

userTags.description: INSTAGRAM USER TAGS — usernames, or { username, x, y } (0–1 on the image); same rules as schedule_post’s userTags.

videoVolume.description: INSTAGRAM REEL — how loud the video’s own sound plays under the track, 0–100 (Instagram’s default 100; 0 = the track alone). Needs audioId.

visibility.description: NOTE: changing this without also naming visibilityByChannel clears any per-channel overrides, so "make it all draft" is not a no-op

visibilityByChannel.description: per-channel visibility override, e.g. {tiktok: draft}; values public, unlisted, private or draft

webflowFields.description: WEBFLOW: required collection fields by slug, e.g. {author:"<item id>"}

whopExperienceId.description: WHOP — move it to a different forum or chat (exp_…, from list_whop_destinations).

whopPaywallCents.description: WHOP: forum-post paywall in cents (needs a title)

whopVisibility.description: WHOP: who can see the forum post

xArticle.description: X: replaces the X Article (title, headings); {} makes it an ordinary X post again.

headings.description: blocks (default) keeps real headings; text turns headings into bold lines

title.description: X Article headline; the post text becomes the article body in markdown

xQuotePostId.description: X — the post this one QUOTES; an empty string removes the quote. Named apart from the Threads `quotePostId` on this same schedule.

yourBrand.description: TIKTOK — the own-brand disclosure; false turns it off.
